strategic_position.ripple_stated_xrp_goal: drive XRP liquidity, utility and trust
strategic_position.counter_hypothesis: RLUSD distribution and collateral utility may grow without proportional XRP demand; XRP use depends on route, fee, bridge and inventory choices.

hypotheses.statement: Moving one percent of $16T product volume on-chain would equal $160B activity.
support: CEO stated one percent arithmetic and 2027 conversion measurement.
disconfirming: 99.9 percent of Treasury and 99 percent plus of Prime described as off-chain.
No asset split; on-chain activity may use RLUSD, XRP or other assets.
hypotheses.next_test: Track on-chain volumes by product, asset, network, corridor and customer.

hypotheses.statement: Future on-chain conversion creates proportional XRP demand.
support: CEO says Ripple wants to drive XRP liquidity and utility.
disconfirming: RLUSD and tokenized assets can move without XRP as bridge; no asset split disclosed.
hypotheses.next_test: Measure XRP bridge volume, inventory, velocity and DEX pathing.

hypotheses.statement: About half of RLUSD is on XRPL.
disconfirming: XRP Insights Oct31 reports 29.2 percent; Stablecoin Insider Oct27 reports 39.4 percent; DefiLlama Oct29 derived estimate about $978M.
hypotheses.next_test: Pinned XRPL issuer/holder balances and Ethereum contract totalSupply with consistent exclusions.

hypotheses.statement: SC custody and LMAX collateral mirroring may create institutional RLUSD collateral rails.
support: SC says XRPL RLUSD custody is live for eligible clients; Ripple financed LMAX $150M.
disconfirming: Collateral mirroring remains planned; no balances or utilization.
hypotheses.next_test: Verify production launch, eligible products, haircuts, balances and utilization.

hypotheses.statement: Ripple Treasury account support may reduce corporate friction for XRP holdings.
support: Official digital asset account feature supports XRP and RLUSD; CEO says platform touches over 1,000 corporates.
disconfirming: No customer balances or payment routing disclosed.
hypotheses.next_test: Obtain adoption, holdings and asset-specific transaction data.
